I've been toying around with trying to get into blacksmithing. I've built a brake drum forge and tried a couple of times to bang some stuff out but could never make anything quality. Is there a good place for beginners to lean the very basics to build a good foundation? Any specific youtube channels that are good for teaching beginners?
What are some good resources for beginners.

In general, and for people who want to learn blacksmithing, Youtube is a very poor resource. Although there are some very good videos there, they are overwhelmed by videos of people with little or no actual knowledge of smith work directing people to do things improperly or to make things that will never work. A far better way to begin to learn the craft is to take lessons from one of the many ABANA affiliated State blacksmithing groups.

The ABANA web site has a link to locate affiliate groups around the country.

https://www.abana.org/resources/chf.shtml

If you are not in the U.S., then I cannot offer any suggestions.
